name: 23605 · Newport News, VA
findings: ZIP 23605 (Newport News) has 30 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (64% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 23605 (Newport News) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 23605 (Newport News) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 35% of the typical level).
